usageNotes: Use this to read datacenter-wide settings such as keyboard layout, HTTP proxy, email address, migration network, console type, and HA/bandwidth defaults. Requires the `Sys.Audit` privilege on `/`; without it, the response is silently filtered and only a subset of options is returned. No parameters are required — the endpoint always returns the current cluster configuration object.

examples.summary: Fetch all datacenter options for the cluster

tips: The response shape varies by privilege level — a token scoped below `Sys.Audit` on `/` will receive a reduced object without warning.
Pair with `update_cluster_options` (PUT /cluster/options) when you need to read-then-modify a specific setting.
Useful as a pre-flight check to confirm migration network, HA settings, or email relay before making cluster-wide changes.
